name: Ian Browne

keyDecisions: Stayed in NI rather than relocating to London or SF.
Built over 8 years before exit — patience over rapid scaling.
lessons: NI is a viable founding base if the domain (healthcare) doesn't demand SF/NYC density.
Long builds (8+ years) can still produce strong exits — speed is not the only winning strategy.

keyDecisions: Reinvested wealth + time into NI startup ecosystem rather than relocating post-exit.
Builds infrastructure (hubs / programs / capital) for next-generation NI founders.
lessons: After an exit, the highest-leverage use of capital + experience in a small ecosystem is to make it easier for the next generation.
